Name: Marsh Meadows Farm
Author: Draylon
Description:
A Tall Custom Farm, with Cliffs, a Large Lake (Mountain Fish), and a dedicated forest section at the bottom (With Forest Forage and Respawning Stumps). With Tillable Grass, and a lot of berry bushes.
(I did get lazy though so I didn't make a custom Worldmap)


Please Let Me know If I made a mistake, something isn't working properly or you notice anything odd.


This map is a Custom Farm Type! This means to play on it you will have to select a new file and then click the side arrow and select the correct map!

NOTE: ALL CUSTOM FARM MAPS HAVE THE MONSTER CHECKBOX IN EXTRA OPTIONS CHECKED, IF YOU DONT WANT MONSTERS ON THE FARM, UNCHECK IT!!

Should be compatible with most mods, however it is built using 1.5 features so sorry Mobile users :(

https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12717
